data.narrative:
Marvel Fusion is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Moritz von der Linden that has raised over $400M to date. The valuation universe for nuclear energy comprises 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Aalo Atomics, though the narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier is limited.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable. Using total capital raised of $400M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series B to next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $760M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum threshold (3+ datapoints required; only 1 adjacent-stage peer identified).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $646M to $874M, with a median point of $760M. This estimate carries meaningful uncertainty given reliance on a single methodology and the nascent nature of the nuclear energy sector, where comparable transaction multiples and growth profiles remain volatile. Refinement would benefit from additional late-stage private nuclear transactions or clearer path-to-profitability metrics differentiating Marvel Fusion's technology maturity within the competitive set.
